description: List this workspace's campaigns (sequences), newest first. A campaign is NOT a broadcast: it is an ordered sequence of messages sent 1:1 to leads who enrol continuously over days, whereas a broadcast is one message fanned out to a resolved audience once. Each row carries step_count, span_days (the total wait across the sequence) and source_count.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
